title.en_US: Vinput 2.3.19 — PipeWire mono channel fix & diagnostics
title.zh_CN: Vinput 2.3.19 — 修复 PipeWire 单声道连线与完善调试状态

text.en_US:
1) Fix PipeWire Capture on Older Systems: Explicitly specify SPA_AUDIO_CHANNEL_MONO in stream configuration, allowing session managers (like WirePlumber 0.4.8 on Ubuntu 22.04) to successfully route and link physical stereo microphone hardware to the capture stream.

2) PipeWire State Diagnostics: Hooked state_changed listener to report real-time stream state transitions in daemon logs for improved observability.
text.zh_CN:
1）修复老版本系统 PipeWire 录音连线问题：在音频流参数中显式指定 SPA_AUDIO_CHANNEL_MONO，解决 Ubuntu 22.04 / WirePlumber 0.4.8 等早期会话管理器无法将物理立体声麦克风阵列连线到采集流导致的静音问题。

2）完善底层音频状态诊断：新增 state_changed 状态机监听，可在调试日志中实时查看 PipeWire 流连接与错误状态。
